scope: Bounded new free-source screening and provisional clinical-photo intake only. No model scoring, diagnosis by AI, training, deployment, contact or account creation.

queries.Lupus: ("discoid lupus"[Title] OR "cutaneous lupus"[Title]) AND ("case report"[Title] OR "case reports"[Publication Type])
queries.Psoriasis: ("plaque psoriasis"[Title] OR "psoriasis vulgaris"[Title]) AND ("case report"[Title] OR "case reports"[Publication Type])
queries.Tinea: ("tinea corporis"[Title] OR "tinea cruris"[Title] OR "tinea faciei"[Title] OR "tinea incognito"[Title]) AND ("case report"[Title] OR "case reports"[Publication Type])

query_suffix: AND open_access[filter] NOT pmc embargo[filter] AND 2016/01/01:2026/11/06[Publication Date]
sort: pub date, as returned by NCBI ESearch; fixed first8 per query
source_version: Use earliest numerically available non-manuscript/non-retracted OA article version with license in allowlist. Archive all metadata decisions, full JATS only after license passes.
rule: Narrow exact source title and figure-caption disease names only; no broad alias mapping or mixing diagnoses. Exclude microscopy/dermoscopy/lab/chart, post-treatment or mixed before-after captions and third-party credits. No crops or generated images; keep original source bytes. Each article is a conservative proxy group, not verified patient identity. Each figure is one file, panels are not counted as separate patients.
retrieval: NCBI ESearch <=2req/s and anonymous official PMC S3 metadata/JATS/media per current2026 docs. No HTML scraping or obsolete FTP/OA endpoint. Verify MD5 supplied in object URL, then byte/pixel/dHash and dimensions. Max20MB/object, at most3 graphic candidates/article, max72 images/24articles. All selected files remain provisional until visual modality/rights checks and a separate training protocol.
protection: Historical cached union19635 rows, plus all new candidates. Connect samearticle, exact byte/pixel or dHashHamming<=3 transitively; any existing-source hit or cross-label component quarantines entire component. Do not redownload/restore deleted corpora. No model error/loss/accuracy used in search or candidate choice.
limitations: Author-reported diagnoses and captions are not a new clinical review in this project.
Case reports can be atypical and source-shifted; new files need not improve model scores.
Article-level groups and hashes do not establish new or independent patients.
Search and copyright checks are bounded; figure-specific exceptions may require manual rejection.
Queries and three example source pages were inspected exploratorily before registration; no model output was used.
